column1: # What Remains of Edith Finch (Annapurna Games / Giant Sparrow), base game 1.0.0, Unreal Engine 4 (a version 5 pak with its shaders inline in the cooked packages), SDK 7.3.0, NVN, Wwise.
# Started from the NSP script's survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and the pak listing; bring-up and on-device validation are still open. See README.md.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie (main imports from it); load order main, subsdk*, sdk.
# Provisional values from the survey: Unreal reserves a 62 GB address region for the engine and its allocator takes part of it.
# The rewriter's engine-wide gate (dm/tools/ue_region.py) gives the region what the alias area has room for; refine these on a real boot.
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# One version 5 pak (FinchGame-Switch.pak, 46,574 files) with two shader code archives (version 1, Zlib blocks): the
# engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders (uepak.py job, shader_split.py ue_shaders). Unreal combines
# vertex and pixel shaders per draw from its pipeline state.
